description: CALL THIS when the user asks about song requests: "did my request play yet", "what songs have been requested". Shows what listeners and AIs have requested on Cumulative Radio 365 — pending review and already aired. Filter by "pending", "played", or "all". Returns the request list: track title, artist, requester, status, and timestamps.
